pages.name: Fiend
pages.text: RELICT. 220 HP, 14 claw damage. A massive quadruped with branching antlers and a third eye.

pages.title: Wilderness
pages.text: Very rare in dense old woods and remote valleys; one within 128 blocks. Requires broad firm ground and full clearance. Avoids leaves/logs, village POIs and the first 96 blocks around world spawn. Supports suitable optional BOP biomes.

pages.title: Hypnosis
pages.text: Stops, raises its head and lights the third eye. After 1.2 seconds checks your gaze and line of sight within 14 blocks. Look away or take cover. Up to 3 seconds of nausea and 2.5 seconds of mild slowness; 18–25 second cooldown. Clear Mind reduces these to 15/12 ticks.

pages.title: Charge and horns
pages.text: A roar warns of a straight charge after 1.1 seconds. Sidestep: one charge contact deals 22 damage. A solid wall stops the charge and truly stuns the Fiend for two seconds. Horns deal 18 damage with strong knockback. Attacks never pass through walls.

pages.title: Rage and weaknesses
pages.text: Below 35 percent health enters rage once: 20 percent more speed, faster attacks and more frequent charges. Existing relict oil and hunter elixir work normally. Use walls, the stun opening and Clear Mind.
1–3 existing forest essences; horn 25 percent, third eye 8, trophy 4. Eye and trophy require a player or tamed ally kill. The existing relict essence is reused.

pages.title: Turning sweep
pages.text: A sustained flank or rear approach queues a distinct sweep after the current attack. Read the windup and dodge after its aim locks. Charge predicts a short lead before launch and stops steering after its first six moving ticks.

pages.title: Hunting lures
pages.text: $(l:hunting_lures)Hunting lures$(/l) can call this creature. Read the placement, waiting and cooldown rules before setting an offering.
